title: "October 2026: Airborne Delay at SEA"
output: html_document

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
```

```{r load, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)

flights <- read_csv("data/processed/flights.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
loops   <- read_csv("data/processed/loops.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Who is making the loops?

Classify each loop's callsign: airlines use 3 letters then numbers (ASA416), US private aircraft use N-numbers (N517MS).

```{r}
loops <- loops |>
  mutate(
    callsign = replace_na(callsign, ""),
    operator = case_when(
      str_detect(callsign, "^[A-Z]{3}[0-9]") ~ "airline-style",
      str_detect(callsign, "^N[0-9]")        ~ "private (N-number)",
      callsign == ""                         ~ "no callsign",
      TRUE                                   ~ "other"
    )
  )

loops |> count(is_arrival, operator)
```

## The busiest loopers

If a handful of callsigns make many loops each, they are training, survey or military flights, not holds.

```{r}
loops |> count(callsign, operator, sort = TRUE) |> head(15)
```

## How big are the loops?

Airline holds are big (tens of km). Practice laps around a runway are small. The detector now ignores loops under 8 km, based on an earlier version of this chart.

```{r}
ggplot(loops, aes(size_km, fill = operator)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2) +
  labs(x = "Loop size (km)", y = "Number of loops", fill = NULL)
```

## How the 70 m/s speed rule was chosen

In an earlier run, a training fleet with airline-style callsigns (RFS) made most of the "airline holds." Its loops were all slower than about 60 m/s, while airliners loop at about 100 to 150 m/s, so the detector now ignores loops slower than 70 m/s. With that rule in place, only airliner loops remain below.

```{r}
holds <- loops |>
  filter(is_arrival, is_airline)

holds |>
  summarise(
    loops        = n(),
    median_speed = round(median(avg_speed, na.rm = TRUE)),
    median_alt   = round(median(avg_alt, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

ggplot(holds, aes(avg_speed, avg_alt, color = type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "Average ground speed in the loop (m/s)",
       y = "Average altitude in the loop (m)",
       color = NULL)
```

## Airline arrivals at SEA: how many were delayed?

```{r}
arrivals <- flights |>
  filter(is_arrival, is_airline)

arrivals |>
  summarise(
    arrivals    = n(),
    with_loop   = sum(n_loops > 0),
    percent     = round(100 * mean(n_loops > 0), 1),
    total_loops = sum(n_loops)
  )
```

What kind of loops were they, and who flew them?

```{r}
holds |> count(type)
holds |> count(callsign, sort = TRUE) |> head(10)
```

## Delays by day

```{r}
daily <- arrivals |>
  mutate(date = as_date(as_datetime(end_time, tz = "America/Los_Angeles"))) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise(arrivals = n(), delayed = sum(n_loops > 0))

ggplot(daily, aes(date, delayed)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Arrivals with at least one loop",
       title = "Airborne delay at SEA, October 2026")
```

## Validation: checking the detector by hand

Helpers to load the raw positions for any one flight from the hourly files.

```{r}
# Hourly file that contains a given Unix time
hour_file <- function(t) {
  h <- as_datetime(floor(t / 3600) * 3600, tz = "UTC")
  sprintf("data/raw/hours/sea_%s_%02dutc.csv", format(h, "%Y-%m-%d"), hour(h))
}

# All positions for one aircraft between two times, across however many hour files that spans
flight_positions <- function(id, start, end) {
  hours <- seq(floor(start / 3600) * 3600, floor(end / 3600) * 3600, by = 3600)
  read_csv(hour_file(hours),
           col_types = cols(icao24 = "c", callsign = "c", .default = "d")) |>
    filter(icao24 == id, time >= start, time <= end) |>
    arrange(time)
}
```

Pick the flights to check: 30 detected at random, and the 30 longest arrivals with no loop found. The seed makes the random pick the same every time.

```{r}
set.seed(42)

detected <- arrivals |>
  filter(n_loops > 0) |>
  slice_sample(n = 30) |>
  mutate(sample = "detected")

undetected <- arrivals |>
  filter(n_loops == 0) |>
  slice_max(minutes, n = 30) |>
  mutate(sample = "not detected (longest)")

to_label <- bind_rows(detected, undetected) |>
  mutate(id = row_number())

labels_path <- "data/processed/labels.csv"
if (!file.exists(labels_path)) {
  to_label |>
    transmute(id, sample, icao24, callsign, minutes = round(minutes), n_loops,
              label = "", notes = "") |>
    write_csv(labels_path)
}
```

Draw one flight: red path, green start, black end, blue circle on each detected loop.

```{r}
show_flight <- function(k) {
  f <- to_label[k, ]
  pos <- flight_positions(f$icao24, f$start_time, f$end_time)
  found <- loops |>
    filter(icao24 == f$icao24, start_time >= f$start_time, end_time <= f$end_time)

  m <- leaflet(pos, height = 350) |>
    addTiles() |>
    addPolylines(lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, color = "red", weight = 3) |>
    addCircleMarkers(data = head(pos, 1), lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
                     color = "green", radius = 6, label = "start") |>
    addCircleMarkers(data = tail(pos, 1), lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
                     color = "black", radius = 6, label = "end")

  if (nrow(found) > 0) {
    m <- m |>
      addCircleMarkers(data = found, lng = ~center_lon, lat = ~center_lat,
                       color = "blue", radius = 12, label = ~type)
  }

  m |> addControl(paste0("#", k, "  ", f$callsign, "  |  ", f$sample,
                         "  |  ", round(f$minutes), " min"),
                  position = "topright")
}
```

All 60 flights, one map each. Knit this file to scroll through them.

```{r}
htmltools::tagList(lapply(seq_len(nrow(to_label)), show_flight))
```

## Validation results

Labels come from a visual review of each flight's path (AI-assisted), made without seeing the detector's answer.

```{r}
labels <- read_csv("data/processed/labels.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

checked <- to_label |>
  select(id, sample, callsign, n_loops) |>
  left_join(labels |> select(id, label, notes), by = "id")

checked |> count(sample, label)

checked |>
  filter(sample == "detected") |>
  summarise(
    checked   = n(),
    real_loop = sum(label != "none"),
    precision = round(100 * mean(label != "none"))
  )

checked |>
  filter(sample == "not detected (longest)") |>
  summarise(
    checked      = n(),
    missed_loops = sum(label != "none")
  )
```
